messages:
Alex: Heads-up — e2e perf gate on main failed for the inference suite after the latest merge. p99 jumped way up on the kv-cache scenario. CI job: https://ci.redwood/internal/job/5743 :eyes:
CI-bot: Job #5743 failed: e2e/perf-gate (p99 > threshold). Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/internal/job/5743/artifacts
Alex: Summary from the artifacts:
```
test: e2e/inference/kv_cache_throughput
p50: 85ms  p95: 210ms  p99: 380ms  (baseline p99 ~ 210ms)
peak-concurrency: 32
commit: 2c1f9a4 -> main
```
Maria: Ugh. Is this consistent across regions or just us-east-1? Any infra bumps last night?
Sam: Quick check — can someone try a rerun with the same job config (no changes) to rule out flake? If it reproduces we start a bisect.
Jordan: If rerun fails, I can kick off a bisect across commits from the last green (2b9e..2c1f). Who owns 2c1f9a4?
Alex: That commit is the quant-kernel bump PR (owner: @Ryan). Also there was a tiny autoscaler tweak merged yesterday (infra/scale).
Ryan: I saw the kernel bump, but it was supposed to be performance-neutral. I'll look immediately. Ping me if you need me to revert.
Maria: metrics-bot, can you link the perf dashboard for that test?
metrics-bot: Dashboard: https://metrics.redwood/dashboards/kvcache?range=24h
Sam: Rerun started (manual) — job #5743-rerun kicked off by Sam.
CI-bot: Rerun #5743-rerun started. Logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/job/5743/rerun/logs
Alex: Rerun completed and... it still shows p99 at ~360ms. Not a one-off.
Jordan: Ok let's bisect. I'll spin up a bisect job that runs the perf scenario with 8 trials per commit. Starting range 2b9e -> 2c1f9a4. ETA ~ 2hrs.
Maria: Also double-check the runtime kernel selector flags — if a kernel fallback landed that forces a slower path at certain sequence lengths that could explain the jump.
Sam: Noted. I'll diff the runtime config deployed on infra against the previous deploy.
Ryan: If bisect points at the quant bump I'll prepare a hotfix revert.
Alex: Thanks. Plan: Jordan runs bisect, Sam verifies runtime selector diffs, Ryan standing by to revert. Please post results back here and @channel if bisect narrows it down. :thumbsup:
Jordan: Starting bisect now. Will update with first culprit commit or when I need help reproducing locally.
Maria: Thanks all — appreciate the quick triage.
